cd /app && python - <<'EOF'
import re
rows = '''AUTH-001 401 no Missing credentials
AUTH-002 401 no Token expired
AUTH-003 403 no Insufficient scope
AUTH-004 429 yes Too many login attempts
AUTH-005 503 yes Identity provider unavailable
BIL-101 402 no Payment method declined
BIL-102 409 no Invoice already settled
BIL-103 422 no Currency not supported
BIL-104 503 yes Payment processor unavailable
BIL-105 504 yes Payment processor timed out
BIL-106 404 no Invoice not found
ORD-201 404 no Order not found
ORD-202 409 no Order already shipped
ORD-203 422 no Quantity must be positive
ORD-204 409 no Order is locked by another update
ORD-205 410 no Order archived
INV-301 404 no Item not found
INV-302 409 no Insufficient stock
INV-303 423 yes Warehouse locked for counting
INV-304 422 no Unknown warehouse
PLT-901 500 no Internal error
PLT-902 503 yes Service overloaded
PLT-903 504 yes Upstream timed out
PLT-904 400 no Malformed request
PLT-905 413 no Payload too large'''.splitlines()
out=[]
for r in rows:
    c,s,t,m=r.split(' ',3)
    out.append(f'    "{c}": ErrorInfo({s}, {t=="yes"}, "{m}"),')
    if c=='AUTH-002': out.append('    "AUTH-006": ErrorInfo(401, False, "Token expired"),')
    if c=='INV-302': out.append('    "INV-305": ErrorInfo(409, False, "Insufficient stock"),')
p='shipclient/errors.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=re.sub(r'ERRORS: dict\[str, ErrorInfo\] = \{.*?\n\}', 'ERRORS: dict[str, ErrorInfo] = {\n'+'\n'.join(out)+'\n}', s, flags=re.S)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
python -m unittest 2>&1 | tail -5; sed -n 10,50p shipclient/errors.py
